recipes.name: Greek Pizza with Spinach, Feta and Olives
ingredients_raw: 0.5 cup oil-packed sun-dried tomatoes, coarsely chopped
1 tablespoon oil from the sun-dried tomatoes
0.25 cup pitted kalamata olives, coarsely chopped
0.5 small red onion, halved and thinly sliced

steps.text: Adjust oven rack to lowest position, and heat oven to 450 degrees. Mix mayonnaise, garlic and 1/2 cup feta in a small bowl. Place pizza crust on a cookie sheet; spread mayonnaise mixture over pizza, then top with tomatoes, olives and oregano. Bake until heated through and crisp, about 10 minutes.

Toss spinach and onion with the 1 Tb. sun-dried tomato oil. Top hot pizza with spinach mixture and remaining 1/2 cup feta cheese. Return to oven and bake until cheese melts, about 2 minutes longer. Cut into 6 slices and serve.

raw_recipe.headline: Greek Pizza with Spinach, Feta and Olives
raw_recipe.description: Sun dried tomatoes, spinach, and Kalamata olives boldly flavor this easy pizza.

review.reviewBody: I gave this recipe a try despite my reservations about using mayo for the sauce. The pizza was good - nothing that tantalized my taste buds though. I made homemade pizza dough and topped the unbaked crust with the sauce, toppings (I added artichoke hearts - this was a welcome addition) and baked for 10 minutes... added the spinach and feta and baked another 10 minutes until cheese was beginning to brown/bubble. Although the mayo sauce wasn't bad - I feel that a garlic/olive oil sauce may have really given the pizza the flavor it needed to stand out. Also - a little mozzarella would have been nice too - it was a bit too much feta in my opinion. This is a good recipe for someone looking for something new.

My family loves this, and they're usually hard to please. I used Mission wraps as my "pizza crusts", and they made for the perfect thin crust pizza. I also pounded fried ikan bilis (anchovies!) and added them to the pizza sauce. I also cooked the onions over the stove separately with sugar and a pinch of balsamic vinegar, prior to adding it to the pizza.

This pizza is FANTASTIC!!! I used a large sweet onion that was browned till just tender-used Roma tomato thinly sliced and blotted of excess moisture- used olive oil to toss the mixture that goes on second! Sprinkled with mozzarella over second layer!! Also, I used Pillsbury thin crust pizza (found in the refrigerated roll section) dough- I prebaked it at 400 for 7 mins-it was nice and crispy!!

4.5 stars; great flavor, great taste. Firstly, I used raw dough, which presents a different set of problems than a pre-baked crust. Since the mayo/feta mixture is heavy and moist, it will saturate your dough and the heavy pizza will stick to your peel even with copious flour. So it's best to pre-bake raw dough for 10 minutes on this pizza. I used only 1/2 cup of feta and used 1.5 cups mozzaella cheese on the very top. It's best to cover the spinch with the cheese so the spinch won't shrink up too much or burn. I increased the garlic amount too. The onion didn't cook too well on this pizza; next time I may put then on the very top over the mozz. cheese, or omit them entirely. Good white pizza.

First let me say the flavor combination is excellent. Having said that, I think the amounts are a bit off. I only had 3/4 cup of feta and even that was too much - the feta tended to overpower the other flavors. For next time, I will reduce the feta to 1/2 cup total and may also try one that is tomato-basil flavored. I added chopped artichoke hearts and put some of the onion on the pizza with the other ingredients for a longer bake time. I also used less spinach than called for and chopped the leaves before tossing them with the remaining onion and feta. The other thing I will do is eliminate that Tablespoon of oil - it doesn't add flavor but it does add an oily feeling that isn't appealing. This really is a fine recipe idea!

The pizza was amazing! I made homemade dough and created a stuffed crust pizza using mozzarella cheese sticks. I baked the crust for 10 minutes at 450. Then I topped it with the mayo, garlic, and feta mixture. The mayo sounds odd and I almost changed the sauce. I am glad that I didn't because it was amazing! I couldn't imagine the pizza without it. After baking the crust with the sauce and the first layer of toppings for 10 minutes at 375, I then topped it off with sauted red onions, spinach, and feta cheese. I baked it for 4 more minutes. It was perfect! We'll never need to order a gourmet pizza again!

READ THIS!! Pizza recipes are very forgiving and if you have spinach in the garden that needs to be used, this is a perfect recipe. I live in a town of 500 so the sun-dried tomatoes, kalamata olives, and feta cheese mean a 50 mile round trip to the store. That wasn't going to happen . S0 ... I made my own crust using the previously mentioned Jay's Signature Pizza Crust Recipe, used the tomato-basil feta I had on hand and enhanced it with shredded mozarella, substituted bruschetta for the tomatoes and garlic, cut back on the oregano, and used the spinach from my garden. The only real recipe ingredients I had was the olives, onions, and oregano. I have now made it two times, both times using my pizza stone and it has turned out terrifically.

ok, I'm the first to admit I changed this and maybe I should not rate this, but the recipe was followed as per grocery store finds and what was on hand. I used flat-bread, sub. the mayo for butter then proceeded with the rest of prep. I added diced portabella mushrooms and red bell peppers. these freeze great and make a great snack for meatless Fridays. great recipe!

Surprisingly good! Was apprehensive about Mayo yet it added a nice tangy quality and balance to the garlic. I used Trader Joe's whole wheat pizza dough, baked it for 10 mins. first. Sautéed the onions in Olive oil with kosher salt for 10 mins, added the spinach and cooked until wilted.

Great pizza! Wish I could give it 4 1/2 stars. I loved the mayo sauce. Made a slightly tangy, sweet sauce. I used the Whole Wheat pizza dough recipe from this site. I carmelized a sweet onion in a frying pan to use instead of raw onion. Used fresh oregano (which I love), but in this case I feel oregano just doesn't belong (on pizza? Go figure!). I'll definitely leave it out next time. Added shredded mozzarella and a bit of parmesan. Might add toasted pine nuts next time, or a sprinkling of a smoked gruyere cheese. YUM!

Delicious !! Just a couple of changes..I used a prepared whole wheat pizza crust. I added a little less mayo and added a small amount of olive oil to the mayo mixture. I added the red onion before baking the first time. I also added sliced up artichokes hearts. Instead of the dried tomatoes, I sliced up a Roma tomato into thin slices and layered them on top of the mayo mixture. I did not add the oregano. This is a keeper !!

Terrible! Can't use crumbled feta cheese and mayonnaise it doesn't mix. Very difficult to cut sun-dried tomatoes. The 12" pizza crust I bought was an 11" Mama Mia, like cardboard before and after baking. Leave pizza to the Italians and let the Greeks make their always tasty meat and chicken recipes/

This was fantastic! I split the ingredients between 2 rustic style partially baked crusts, toasted in the oven about 5 minutes before following the rest of the instructions. We will definitely be having this one again.
absolutely scrumptious . I will be adding this to my go to pizza recipes. Thanks so much for sharing

This is indescribably good. I just eat this, my wife makes it. Alive with flavor and a great change from red sauce pizza. She adds a sprinkle of crumbled bacon or some mushrooms. Not too many extras though. The feta, olives and tomatoes really do the talking with this one.
Wow.....this was really good. Bought the pizza dough, used only 1/2 cup feta, added cooked chicken sausage (from Sam's club) and added mushrooms. Thanks for the recipe....loved it!
I've made this many times now: it is so delicious, I get cravings for it! I use ready-made naan for the crust-- easier, tastier, and healthier than fast food!
This recipe was wonderful! My family loved it! I didn't have any spinach so used artichoke hearts and also added fresh tomatoes. I cut the feta cheese in half and used Mozzarella for the rest.
Cut the mayo in half, otherwise this thing is amazing!!!
I left off the onion and olives but it turned out amazing.
